resources.string: Reuse unpacked graphics files instead of rewriting ~170 MB on every launch
If a game stops starting, the next launch unpacks all graphics files fresh
The next game launch will repair its graphics files
A small notice every hour you play
See your chip, GPU and what Vapor tuned for this phone
Detect this phone again and reset the default FPS cap for new games
Tuned for a %1$s phone: new games start capped at %2$d FPS
%1$d FPS for games you haven\'t tweaked (tap to change)
Hide touch controls when you use a controller; touch the screen to bring them back
Touch controls fade after 4 seconds untouched so you can see the game
When the phone overheats, drop to 45 FPS (30 if critical) until it cools, instead of stuttering
Silences notifications during games and turns them back on when you exit
Allow Vapor in the list so it can turn on Do Not Disturb
Android sustained-performance mode: slightly lower peak, much less throttling in long sessions
Lock screen to max refresh rate
Keeps 120 Hz screens from dropping refresh rate in game. Uses more battery
Start games at 30 FPS when Battery Saver or Game Booster battery mode is on
Show a notice when the phone overheats or the battery drops below 15%
